new_observations.original_quote: institutional e-mail addresses are not accepted

new_observations.scope: 2027 incoming特定non-OECD雙條件；財力文件不是費用估計
new_observations.original_quote: nationals of, and enrolled at universities in, non-OECD countries only

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST 2027春季3/1–6/18、秋季8/30–12/17；春迎新2/26暫定、秋8/27；宿舍入住日及迎新詳程仍可能變動並另行通知。

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST 2027表列春提名10/1、申請10/15，秋提名4/1、申請4/15；母校先電郵提名再學生用碼填表。表未在截止列寫年份，不自行換成2027春於2027/10申請；開課年份另明確。
new_observations.scope: 2027 incoming factsheet中月日常年表，非完整年月日確認
new_observations.original_quote: Spring [October 1] [October 15]

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST 2027學士一般12–24、碩士9–12 credits／學期，但母校允許可少修、校方不因低於最低量處罰交換生；跨UG／grad限Y互認課，研究生修UG另需advisor及系主任核准。Medical Science／Engineering及Seoul Business不開放。
new_observations.scope: 2027 incoming exchange；最低修課可依母校例外，非硬性無豁免
new_observations.original_quote: Lower loads possible if permitted by home institution.

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST 2027宿舍入住須Health Check Form含MMR疫苗狀態及結核IGRA或胸部X光，結果限入住前三月內；MMR第一／第二劑間需兩週，按時提交才可配宿舍。屬錄取後入住條件，不是母校初申文件。
new_observations.scope: 2027 incoming Daejeon宿舍健康表；入住阶段
new_observations.original_quote: Results are only valid if dated within 3 months prior to move-in.

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST 2027由校方替所有交換生申請Daejeon校內雙／三人宿舍，入學前另作宿舍survey，估USD550–900／學期；AI與Mobility學生也住Daejeon。此為安排通則及估算，不当個人房间分配證明。
new_observations.scope: 2027 incoming Daejeon宿舍；非Seoul，非学位生奖学金
new_observations.original_quote: Approximately USD 550 – 900 per semester

new_observations.text_zh: KAIST交換D-2含D-2-6須參加NHI，取得Residence Number前可能數月未保障，官網強烈推薦預先買過渡旅遊保險；2027表建議至少首月。學位生SHIA KRW45,000／學期及KAIST學士獎學金NHI退費不套交換。
new_observations.scope: incoming exchange保險通則未標學年；SHIA／學位獎學金另排
new_observations.original_quote: Every exchange student holding a D-2 visa (including D-2-6) is subject to mandatory subscription

new_observations.text_zh: POSTECH原incoming交換頁以Course Taking (C)為預設；想做Research Combined (C+R)者須自己聯繫POSTECH教授／實驗室並於申請前另備Letter of Approval，不能將研究同意書要求套全部一般修課交換生。
new_observations.scope: incoming partner UG／graduate exchange；C與C+R分開，未標學年
new_observations.original_quote: need to prepare a Letter of Approval document additionally before applying.

new_observations.text_zh: POSTECH宿舍公開規則要求入住前向承辦者提交結核診斷證明，申請時表示同意住宿規章；這是入住程序，不是母校初申交換附件或只按簽證高風險國籍適用。
new_observations.scope: Pohang現行宿舍規章，2026/9/15更新；入住階段
new_observations.original_quote: You must submit the "tuberculosis diagnosis certificate" to the person in charge before moving in.

new_observations.text_zh: POSTECH自2026春生效之宿舍表一般雙人房KRW149,000／學士每4週或研究生每月；其餘RC、單人與Community不同。Community另需押金700,000及utilities100,000／學期。這不是2027–28交換DICE個人房型報價，不能將單位混成一學期。
new_observations.scope: Pohang宿舍表自2026春；學士每4週／研究生每月不同，DICE未單列價格
new_observations.original_quote: Effective from Spring Semester 2026

new_observations.text_zh: POSTECH公開ISSS簽證頁將交換生列D-2適用身分；停留超過90日者到韓國後90日内辦外國人登記。通用文件為護照／簽證影本、表、6月內白底3.5×4.5cm照片、KRW30,000程序費及住址證明；D-2另需在學證明，需按個案簽證身分核對。
new_observations.scope: POSTECH ISSS公開通則未標年度；抵韓後登記，非初申交換資格
new_observations.original_quote: All foreigners staying in Korea for longer than 90 days must register within 90 days

new_observations.text_zh: Umeå瑞典語頁2026/10/7更新明說2027不提供incoming交換生瑞典語課（亦特別說Spring2027不開）。較舊FAQ／選課通則可加瑞典語至45ECTS只是常年說法，不代表2027有課；付費／獎學金生免費學語言為別身分。
new_observations.scope: incoming交換2027瑞典語供課限定；非一般英授課程停開
new_observations.original_quote: will not offer Swedish language courses for incoming exchange students in 2027.

new_observations.text_zh: Umeå國際指南列居留申請需全段可支用保證財力，舊2025額SEK10,584／月並明說每年更新；這是2025移民財力要求，非2027–28生活費估計或交換招生GPA。非EU長於3月須居留、30credits全時，不能把付費生先繳學費才審居留套免學費交換。
new_observations.scope: international student guide2026/6/26更新；財力數據明2025舊年，身分分別
new_observations.original_quote: The sum for 2025 is SEK 10,584 per month.

new_observations.text_zh: Umeå交換Student IN在瑞典境內24小時保障，非課程的境外旅行不涵蓋；一般personal injury只限學習及直達通勤、FAS+給付費／獎學金生，均不能互相替代。住房／租客保險只是建議、若不足可自加保。
new_observations.scope: incoming正式協定交換之Student IN；國際指南未標適用學年
new_observations.original_quote: the insurance is only valid in Sweden, not if you are travelling abroad (outside of your studies).

new_observations.text_zh: Umeå有居留需求的交換生以上傳Notification of Selection Results證明校方保險；Learning Agreement由IO錄取後簽，Arrival／Stay最早迎新當日簽，不能列作臺大初申已簽文件。錄取課無需回覆，但不參加應在University Admissions自行decline。
new_observations.scope: incoming交換录取後文件與保險證明，常年FAQ
new_observations.original_quote: Upload your Notification of Selection Results as proof of this.

new_observations.text_zh: Umeå Accommodation Service Spring2027推薦抵達1/17，該日亦租約最早入住／取鑰日，首期租金須已付、以護照核身；Infocenter關門時可MyPage Book Pickup登記朋友代領，朋友也須ID。這是前批租約，非Fall2027入住日。
new_observations.scope: Spring2027已簽校方住宿合約者，早於目標Fall2027
